name: Lost Orbit
summary: A 404 page where an astronaut floats inside a glowing ring that forms the zero of 404
about: A full page-not-found template set in space. A canvas starfield twinkles at three depths with shooting stars and a ringed planet, while the zero of 404 is a spinning glowing ring with orbiting dust and a tethered astronaut floating inside it. Visitors can nudge the astronaut for a springy spin and a quip, return home, or report the broken link from an inline form.
how: The page enters in layers: digits drop in, the ring spins up, the astronaut floats into view and the headline rises letter by letter
Move the pointer to shift the stars, ring and astronaut at different depths
Press the astronaut to nudge it: it spins on a spring, puffs its jets and says a new line
Report a broken link opens a small form; Send report winds up, fills with a rocket, then bursts into a green check
Scroll down and the Try these instead cards slide in and tilt toward the pointer
